title: Chapter 614 - 614 Resurrected From The Dead; Undying!
content:
Chapter 614 - 614 Resurrected From The Dead; Undying!

Chapter 614 - 614 Resurrected from the Dead; Undying!

614 Resurrected from the Dead; Undying!

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing’s eyes widened, and her pretty face was filled with disbelief.

As a result, she did not even explain it immediately.

Void Heart: [F*ck! That statue is actually alive!]

Midnight: [Also, it can speak Chinese! What’s going on?]

Dongfanghong: [Little Thunderclap Monastery, Journey to the West… Is the Otherworld really Journey to the West? Journey to the West is a historical record of the Otherworld!]

Zi Mei: [How scary! That monster is so terrifying! Even through the screen, I’m trembling in fear.]

Demon Scorpion: [This is definitely not an ordinary monster. I hope God Lin can defeat it!]]

…

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hu Tian, and the others watched the live broadcast without blinking.

They clenched their small fists and said seriously, “Lin Fan can definitely defeat it!”

Obviously, they were also shocked by the giant monster’s aura and felt its terror.

…

In the Otherworld.

“You are the first batch of humans to come before me. It’s very rare.”

“I haven’t spoken to humans for a long time. Logically speaking, I should have a good chat with you guys to relieve my boredom.

“After all, I’ve been here for too long. It’s too boring.

“But you actually killed Little Gold and Little Silver…How dare you?!”

A terrifying gust of cold wind shot out, blowing away all the falling rocks on the ground and smashing them into the wall in the distance. This directly turned them into powder.

At this moment, Lin Fan, who had not spoken for a long time, finally opened his mouth and said indifferently, “Have you heard of this saying?

“Villains die from talking too much!”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan pulled out his Star Meteorite Sword.

[Sword 1: Draw the sword and slash the sky!]

A sharp sword light shot out from the sky and slashed at the monster’s body.

The sound of metal clashing echoed throughout the scene.

The terrifying sword energy caused the Little Thunderclap Monastery to crack, as if it would collapse at any moment.

A huge wound appeared on the monster’s golden skin, and blood splashed everywhere.

However, it did not fall. Instead, it let out a crazy roar.

“How dare you hurt me?!”

The deafening roar caused the entire palace to tremble.

This was the first time Lin Fan had failed to kill an enemy with a single strike.

Then, the ten snake heads behind the monster opened their mouths and gave off a terrifying aura as they bit at Lin Fan.

Their speed was extremely fast and terrifying!

It was ambush from all sides!

Lin Fan’s expression did not change at all, and he did not have any intention of dodging.

Dodge?

No!

He directly faced them head-on!

Lin Fan took a step forward and brandished his Star Meteorite Sword.

A mountain-like snake head fell heavily to the ground.

Blood splattered!

Lin Fan took another step forward.

Another snake head fell to the ground.

One step to kill one, ten steps to wipe them out!

At this moment, Lin Fan appeared right in front of the monster.

He raised the Star Meteorite Sword again and said, “Slash!”

[Skill: Sword 8!]

A dazzling sword light gushed out and instantly split the monster in half!

No!

It was not only the monster but even the entire land was split into two from the middle!

Little Thunderclap Monastery… collapsed!

A deep ravine appeared in the earth!

His strength was truly terrifying!

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing’s mouth was wide open, completely stunned.

Countless comments poured down like a storm.

Sorrow after Habit: [F*ck!]

Newcomer: [F*ck!]

Silky Whisper: [F*ck!]

…

Countless exclamations filled the entire live broadcast room.

After a long time, other comments began to appear.

Banxia Weiyang: [God Lin is so awesome! God Lin! That’s right! God Lin must be the Sword God!]

Frost Battle Wolf: [I don’t even know what words to use to describe God Lin. I just want to say, he’s f*cking awesome!]

Everyone: [My blood is boiling! No game, movie, or anime can recreate that scene using special effects! Awesome!]

Grand: [God Lin is invincible!]

…

The entire screen was filled with praises for Lin Fan.

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hu Tian, and the others stared at the screen.

They thought back to Lin Fan’s sword movement, and their breathing started to quicken. Their faces turned red.

This was the person they liked!

Amazing!

…

Among the countless excited comments, there was an inconspicuous comment that was quickly wiped out.

Hmm: [Strange, why hasn’t a treasure chest appeared yet?]

…

In the Otherworld…

The monster’s body was cut in half, and blood flowed out.

At this moment, a strange scene appeared.

The sand in the distance seemed to be attracted and flew to the middle of the monster’s broken body.

Then, the two halves of the monster’s body were dragged together and merged.

Furthermore, the monster quickly healed all of its wounds.

The crack in the middle disappeared, and the ten snake heads returned to the monster’s body.

It came back to life!

The monster’s eyes were bloodshot as it said coldly, “You actually killed me once. Very good!”

Lin Fan said calmly, “What’s the use of living?”

As soon as he finished speaking, he swung his sword again.

The dazzling sword light once again split the monster into two from the middle.

But soon, the sand moved again, as if it wanted to glue and repair the monster like before.

Lin Fan squinted his eyes as the Star Meteorite Sword danced in the air.

In the next moment, countless dazzling sword rays condensed in the air.

[Sword 9: 10,000 swords strike together!]

“Go!” Lin Fan shouted.

The sword rays that filled the sky were like a storm, shooting toward the two halves of the monster’s body.

With loud bangs, the monster’s body was cut into countless pieces.

Only then did the entire world fall silent.

However, this silence did not last long.

The sand quickly moved.

Gradually, it reassembled the broken monster’s body.

Not long after, a complete monster appeared in front of Lin Fan.

“You want to kill me?” The monster laughed loudly. “What a joke!

“Do you know that my body is made of sand?

“As long as there’s sand, I can revive!

“This level-nine forbidden area is made entirely of sand, so I can’t die here!”

It was not worried that Lin Fan would find out about its secret.

It was fearless!

Lin Fan’s expression did not change at all.

“You can be resurrected as long as there’s sand? Since that’s the case, I’ll make the sand disappear.”
